title: ApplicationsSetting

ringDevicesForClickToDialCallsEnabled.description: When `true`, indicates to ring devices for outbound Click to Dial calls.

ringDevicesForGroupPageEnabled.description: When `true`, indicates to ring devices for inbound Group Pages.

ringDevicesForCallParkEnabled.description: When `true`, indicates to ring devices for Call Park recalled.

browserClientEnabled.description: Indicates that the browser Webex Calling application is enabled for use.

browserClientId.description: Device ID of WebRTC client. Returns only if `browserClientEnabled` is true.

desktopClientEnabled.description: Indicates that the desktop Webex Calling application is enabled for use.

desktopClientId.description: Device ID of Desktop client. Returns only if `desktopClientEnabled` is true.

tabletClientEnabled.description: Indicates that the tablet Webex Calling application is enabled for use.

tabletClientId.description: Device ID of Tablet client. Returns only if `tabletClientEnabled` is true.

mobileClientEnabled.description: Indicates that the mobile Webex Calling application is enabled for use.

mobileClientId.description: Device ID of Mobile client. Returns only if `mobileClientEnabled` is true.

availableLineCount.description: Number of available device licenses for assigning devices/apps.

description: Application services settings for a user. Application services let you determine the ringing behavior for calls made to people in certain scenarios. You can also specify which devices can download the Webex Calling app.
